title: 第121章 暗渔现身秘境收官第120章 密室围杀巨威破扉
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 独角巨兽沉重兽蹄轰然砸落，萧辰连同三名心腹弟子瞬间被狂暴凶威压得动弹不得，腥风席卷之下，四人尽数昏死在地，血肉糊满石壁，再无半分反抗余力。
巨兽甩动覆满暗红硬鳞的庞大身躯，布满嗜血血丝的竖瞳立刻锁定廊道里唯一站立的林宸，粗壮兽爪撕裂气流，带着刺鼻腥臭径直扑杀而来。
林宸脚步轻移避开正面冲击，寂灭道体全速运转，廊道内浓稠天地灵气如同潮水般顺着毛孔涌入四肢百骸，源源不断补充灵力。
他单手握剑，海量灵力尽数灌注剑身，金光轰然暴涨，一道厚重凌厉的剑势横斩而出，精准劈在巨兽脖颈鳞甲衔接的薄弱缝隙。
凄厉震耳的兽吼响彻整条廊道，乌黑腥臭的兽血顺着伤口喷涌洒落。
独角巨兽庞大身躯踉跄后退，力道已然折损大半。
林宸不给对方喘息之机，身形穿梭在巨兽攻势间隙，剑招招奔着兽核要害而去，不出百招，长剑径直刺穿巨兽头颅，稳稳掏出一枚光泽莹润、药力浑厚的高阶异兽内丹。
内丹入手的刹那，精纯药力顺着指尖渗入经脉，丹田之内积蓄已久的灵力轰然躁动，距离炼气八层的瓶颈只剩薄薄一层阻隔。
就在林宸低头收好内丹的片刻，破败密室深处的阴影里，三道蛰伏许久的身影骤然暴起，四件法器寒光直刺林宸后背心门。
这三人皆是炼气八层修为，自萧辰四人动手偷袭时便藏身暗处冷眼观望，一心等着双方两败俱伤，坐收异兽内丹与沿途采摘的灵药，心思阴狠至极。
可他们全然不知，林宸的神识早已铺开五十丈范围，密室每一处阴影的动静都被尽数捕捉。
林宸旋身转身，长剑挽出一圈密不透风的剑花，借着周遭无穷无尽的灵气补给，以一敌三依旧灵力充沛，不见半分枯竭。
寂灭道体不断消解对方法器打来的冲击，剑势层层递进，不过百回合，三道偷袭者的护身灵力尽数崩碎，重伤吐血瘫倒在地，再无动手之力。
林宸上前收走三人储物袋中全部灵药与法器，目光扫过石壁边萧辰四人毫无生机的躯体。
从踏入秘境伊始，对方三番两次设伏追杀、步步紧逼的仇怨，今日彻底了结，再无后患。
他不再理会满地残骸，迈步走入破碎的密室之中。
石台之上静静平放一枚古朴玉简，正是他深入遗迹一心寻找的淬炼神识上古功法。
指尖触碰到玉简的瞬间，晦涩道韵缓缓流淌而出。
将玉简稳妥收入储物袋，林宸环视整处遗迹廊道。
高阶异兽内丹、天材地宝、上古神识心法尽数到手，数次伏击自己的仇敌、暗处伺机夺宝的渔翁也全部解决。
廊道尽头尚有几道岔路延伸向未曾探索的偏殿，整片遗迹深处也残留着其他宗门修士活动的痕迹，只是眼下机缘尽得、隐患全消，再耗心力深挖余下角落纯属多余。
林宸转身迈步，顺着廊道出口稳步向外走去，身后破碎石门、巨兽尸身、满地血迹残骸统统被甩在身后。
昏暗的廊道光影缓缓后退，前方隐约透出秘境出口传送阵的柔和天光，这场杀机不断的遗迹秘境之行，至此彻底落幕。
踏出秘境传送光幕，外界山间清风扑面而来，褪去遗迹内终年不散的腥臭凶煞之气。
林宸寻到一处人迹罕至的隐蔽山洞，布下简易隔绝大阵，将秘境所得全部铺陈在石台之上。
高阶独角异兽内丹、数十株珍稀灵药、缴获的各式法器堆积一片。
寂灭道体全力吞吐炼化海量药力，丹田内积压许久的灵力轰然冲破桎梏，平稳踏入炼气八层。
盘膝静坐石床，他指尖抚上古玉简，晦涩古老的神识心法缓缓映入脑海。
日复一日参悟修行，自身神识强度飞速攀升，弥补了先前修为精进过快、神识薄弱的短板。
回想踏入秘境之初，刚入遗迹便遭萧辰一伙伏击，数次深陷死局，全凭寂灭道体得天独厚的灵气吸纳之力一次次死里逃生，一路斩仇敌、夺机缘、破凶兽、平暗处渔翁，步步浴血才换得一身积累。
修行长路漫漫，秘境机缘只是修行途中一站，过往纷争尽数尘埃落定，再无牵绊。
林宸收拾好全部行囊，抬眼望向远方连绵无尽的群山，眼底一片平静澄澈，属于他的修仙道途，自此翻开全新一页。
（全书完）
content_en:
The heavy hooves of the unicorn beast crashed down. Xiao Chen and his three close disciples were instantly suppressed by the violent force and could not move. Sweeping by the fishy wind, all four of them fainted and died on the ground. Their flesh and blood were covered with the stone wall, and they were no longer able to resist.
The giant beast swung its huge body covered with dark red hard scales, and its vertical pupils filled with bloodthirsty bloodshot eyes immediately locked onto Lin Chen, the only one standing in the corridor. Its thick claws tore through the airflow, and it came straight towards him with a pungent stench.
Lin Chen moved his steps lightly to avoid the frontal impact, and the body of Nirvana was running at full speed. The thick spiritual energy of heaven and earth in the corridor poured into the limbs and bones along the pores like a tide, continuously replenishing spiritual power.
He held the sword with one hand, and poured all his spiritual energy into the sword. The golden light suddenly surged, and a thick and sharp sword slashed out, accurately hitting the weak gap where the scales on the neck of the giant beast were connected.
The shrill and ear-splitting roar of the beast resounded throughout the corridor, and black and smelly beast blood spewed down the wound.
The huge body of the unicorn staggered back, with most of its strength lost.
Lin Chen didn't give the opponent a chance to breathe. He shuttled between the giant beast's attacks and moved his sword towards the vital point of the beast's core. Without making a single move, the long sword pierced the giant beast's head and steadily took out a high-level exotic beast inner elixir that was shiny and powerful.
The moment the inner elixir was in hand, the pure medicinal power seeped into the meridians along the fingertips. The spiritual power that had been accumulated for a long time in the dantian was violently agitated. There was only a thin layer of barrier between the bottleneck of the eighth level of Qi refining.
Just when Lin Chen lowered his head to put away the inner elixir, three figures that had been dormant for a long time suddenly emerged from the shadows deep in the ruined secret room, and the cold light of four magical weapons pierced Lin Chen's back vest door.
These three people are all at the eighth level of Qi refining. Ever since Xiao Chen and the other four launched the sneak attack, they had been hiding in the dark and watching coldly, waiting for both sides to suffer losses. They were collecting the inner elixirs of alien beasts and the elixirs picked along the way, with extremely vicious thoughts.
But they had no idea that Lin Chen's consciousness had already spread out to an area of ​​fifty feet, and the movement of every shadow in the secret room was captured.
Lin Chen turned around and drew out a circle of airtight sword flowers with his long sword. With the endless supply of spiritual energy around him, he was still full of spiritual energy with one against three, and was not exhausted at all.
The body of Nirvana continued to absorb the impact of the opponent's magical weapon, and the sword power increased step by step. Within a hundred rounds, all the protective spiritual power of the three sneak attackers collapsed, and they were seriously injured and vomited blood and collapsed on the ground, unable to do anything anymore.
Lin Chen stepped forward and took away all the elixirs and magic weapons in the storage bags of the three people. His eyes swept over the lifeless bodies of Xiao Chen and four others beside the stone wall.
From the beginning of entering the secret realm, the enemy's grudges of repeatedly setting up ambushes to pursue and pursue him step by step were completely ended today, and there will be no further trouble.
He no longer paid attention to the debris on the ground and stepped into the broken secret room.
An ancient jade slip lay quietly on the stone platform. It was the ancient technique for tempering spiritual consciousness that he was looking for after going deep into the ruins.
The moment the fingertips touched the jade slip, the obscure Taoist charm slowly flowed out.
Putting the jade slips safely into the storage bag, Lin Chen looked around the entire ruins corridor.
High-level alien beast inner elixirs, heavenly materials and earthly treasures, and ancient spiritual consciousness and mental techniques were all obtained. The enemies who had ambushed him several times and the fishermen who were waiting in the dark to seize the treasure were all eliminated.
At the end of the corridor, there are still a few forked roads that lead to unexplored side halls. There are also traces of the activities of other sect monks deep in the entire ruins. However, now that the opportunity has been exhausted and the hidden dangers have been eliminated, it is completely redundant to spend time digging into the remaining corners.
Lin Chen turned around and walked steadily out along the corridor exit, leaving behind him the broken stone door, the corpse of the giant beast, and the bloody remains on the ground.
The dim corridor light and shadow slowly retreated, and the soft skylight of the teleportation array at the secret realm's exit was faintly revealed in front of them. This murderous trip to the secret realm of the ruins has come to a complete end.
Stepping out of the teleportation light curtain in the secret realm, the breeze from the outside mountains blows in your face, taking away the stench and evil atmosphere that lingers in the ruins all year round.
Lin Chen found a hidden cave that was rarely visited by people, set up a simple isolation formation, and laid out all the gains from the secret place on the stone platform.
High-level unicorn beast inner elixirs, dozens of rare elixirs, and various captured magical weapons were piled up.
The Nirvana Taoist body swallowed and refined a large amount of medicinal power with all its strength, and the spiritual power that had been accumulated in the Dantian for a long time suddenly broke through the shackles, and smoothly stepped into the eighth level of Qi refining.
Sitting cross-legged on the stone bed, he touched the ancient jade slip with his fingertips, and the obscure and ancient spiritual consciousness slowly came into his mind.
Through enlightenment and practice day after day, the strength of his own spiritual consciousness has increased rapidly, making up for the shortcomings of his previous cultivation that was too fast and his spiritual consciousness was weak.
Recalling the first time I entered the secret realm, I was ambushed by Xiao Chen's group as soon as I entered the ruins. I was trapped in a deadlock several times. I escaped from death time and time again thanks to the unique power of absorbing spiritual energy of the Nirvana Taoist body. I killed enemies, seized opportunities, defeated ferocious beasts, and subdued fishermen in the dark. I shed blood step by step in exchange for accumulation.
The road of spiritual practice is long, and the opportunity of secret realm is just a stop on the way. All the disputes in the past have been settled, and there are no more ties.
Lin Chen packed up all his bags and looked up at the endless mountains in the distance. His eyes were calm and clear. His path to immortality has since turned a new page.
